body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News> JC Hyun Systems(www.myudea.com) presented its electronic dictionary ‘Udea’ during CES 2008.

There are two types of the Udea; the one is ‘Cool 200 series’ adopting 9.5cm LCD and SD memory card slot, and the other is ‘Expert 300’ featuring 11cm LCD with OLED dual display, multimedia functions like DMB, Bluetooth, WiFi and 81 kinds of educational content.

“We continue to develop advanced electronic dictionaries featuring multimedia functions customized for various types of users and for each market situation to penetrate global market as well. The Udea has been focused by a lot of foreign buyers during the show period,” said the company.
